A company offers the following:

I. Successive discounts of 25% and 5%

II Successive discounts of 20% and 10%

III Successive discounts of 22% and 8%

Which offer is the best for a customer?
questions.solution:
Formula used:

Effective discount = 100 - [(100 - discount1) × (100 - discount2) / 100]

Calculations:

I. Successive discounts of 25% and 5%:

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [(100 - 25) × (100 - 5) / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [75 × 95 / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - 71.25 = 28.75%

II. Successive discounts of 20% and 10%:

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [(100 - 20) × (100 - 10) / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [80 × 90 / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - 72 = 28%

III. Successive discounts of 22% and 8%:

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [(100 - 22) × (100 - 8) / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - [78 × 92 / 100]

⇒ Effective discount = 100 - 71.76 = 28.24%

∴ The correct answer is option (4) (Maximum Discount).

questions.question: If the radii of two circles be 8 cm and 6 cm and the length of the transverse common tangent be 14 cm, then the distance between the two centres is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the first circle (r₁) = 8 cm

Radius of the second circle (r₂) = 6 cm

Length of the transverse common tangent (L) = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Distance between the centers (d) = sqrt{(r₁ + r₂)² + L²}

**Calculations:**

d = sqrt{(8 + 6)² + 14²}

⇒ d = sqrt{14² + 14²}

⇒ d = sqrt{2 times 14²}

⇒ d = sqrt{2} times 14

⇒ d = 14√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

The length of the transverse common tangent = AB = 14 cm

The distance between the two centres = D

The radius of two circles r₁ = 8 cm, and r₂ = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

AB=sqrt{D²-(r₁ + r₂)²}

**Calculation:**

14=sqrt{D²-(8+6)²}

⇒ 14²=D²-14²

⇒ 196=D²-196

⇒ D²=392

⇒ D=sqrt{392}

⇒ D=14sqrt{2}

**∴ The distance between the two centres is 14√2 cm.**

questions.question: A policeman follows a thief 1800 metres ahead of him. If the policeman and the thief run at a speed of 12 km/h and 9 km/h, respectively, how much distance thief will cover from spotting point (1800 meters ahead to policeman) before catch by policeman?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio of Policeman to Thief = 12 : 9 = 4 : 3

Since the time taken to meet is constant, Distance ratio = 4 : 3

Difference in distance ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 unit

Here, 1 unit = 1800 m (initial separation distance)

Distance covered by thief = 3 units = 3 × 1800 = 5400 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 5400 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00c94c6b3651cd47ebd5b46513b645f0605a6d0f8a4617d3fc45db9653707878.png] 

**Given:**

Speed of Policeman (Sₚ) = 12 km/h

Speed of Thief (Sₜ) = 9 km/h

Initial separation distance (d) = 1800 m = 1.8 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative speed = Sₚ − Sₜ = 12 − 9 = 3 km/h

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = Distance ÷ Relative speed = 1.8 ÷ 3 = 0.6 hours

⇒ Distance covered by thief = Sₜ × Time taken

⇒ Distance covered by thief = 9 × 0.6 = 5.4 km

⇒ Distance in metres = 5.4 × 1000 = 5400 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 5400 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move towards each other in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed value by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

questions.question: For a certain sum, the amount received after 2 years at 18% p.a. simple interest is Rs.1,100 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 10 years at the same rate. The sum (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the principal sum be 100%.

Amount after 2 years = 100% + (18% × 2) = 136%

Simple interest for 10 years = 18% × 10 = 180%

Difference = 180% − 136% = 44%

Given 44% = ₹1100 ⇒ 100% = (1100 ÷ 44) × 100 = ₹2500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate of Interest (R) = 18% p.a.

Difference between 10 years SI and 2 years Amount = ₹1100

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0e065c35eec156a62247355a1c00770daafcf59f67484379a52117e8a123f01.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the sum (Principal) be P.

⇒ Amount after 2 years = P + (P × 18 × 2) ÷ 100 = P + 0.36P = 1.36P

⇒ Simple Interest for 10 years = (P × 18 × 10) ÷ 100 = 1.80P

⇒ Difference = 1.80P − 1.36P

⇒ 1.80P − 1.36P = 0.44P

⇒ 0.44P = 1100

⇒ P = 1100 ÷ 0.44 = 2500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is calculated only on the principal amount for the entire period. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount

The total sum of money returned at the end of the time period. Formula: Amount = Principal + Simple Interest.

Compound Interest vs Simple Interest Difference

For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI on the same sum is given by: D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: The sum of the first six terms of an arithmetic progression is 54 and the ratio of its 10th term to its 30th term is 11 : 31. What is the sum of its first 15 terms?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the first six terms of an arithmetic progression is 54 and the ratio of its 10th term to its 30th term is 11:31.

**Formula used:**

The sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression (AP) is given by:

Sₙ = n/2 × (2a + (n-1)d)

The nth term of an AP is given by:

aₙ = a + (n-1)d

**Calculation:**

Sum of the first six terms:

S₆ = 6/2 × (2a + 5d) = 54

⇒ 3 × (2a + 5d) = 54

⇒ 2a + 5d = 18 ... (i)

Ratio of 10th term to 30th term:

(a + 9d) / (a + 29d) = 11/31

⇒ 31(a + 9d) = 11(a + 29d)

⇒ 31a + 279d = 11a + 319d

⇒ 20a = 40d

⇒ a = 2d ... (ii)

Substitute a = 2d in equation (i):

2(2d) + 5d = 18

⇒ 4d + 5d = 18

⇒ 9d = 18

⇒ d = 2

Using a = 2d:

⇒ a = 2 × 2 = 4

Sum of the first 15 terms:

S₁₅ = 15/2 × (2a + 14d)

⇒ S₁₅ = 15/2 × (2 × 4 + 14 × 2)

⇒ S₁₅ = 15/2 × (8 + 28)

⇒ S₁₅ = 15/2 × 36

⇒ S₁₅ = 15 × 18

⇒ S₁₅ = 270

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: P and Q together can finish a piece of work in 4 days. If P alone can finish the work in 12 days, then what are the number of days required for Q alone to finish the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P and Q together can finish a work in 4 days.

P alone can finish the work in 12 days.

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 4 and 12, which is 12 units.

Work done by P and Q together in 1 day = 12 units / 4 days = 3 units/day.

Work done by P alone in 1 day = 12 units / 12 days = 1 unit/day.

Work done by Q alone in 1 day = (P+Q)'s 1 day work - P's 1 day work = 3 units/day - 1 unit/day = 2 units/day.

Number of days Q takes to finish the work alone = Total work / Q's 1 day work = 12 units / 2 units/day = 6 days.

**∴ Q alone can finish the work in 6 days.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at the cost price, but he uses false weights with which he cheats by 10% while buying and by 15% while selling. His overall percentage of profit or loss is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shopkeeper cheats 10% while buying ⇒ gets 1.1 kg instead of 1 kg

Shopkeeper cheats 15% while selling ⇒ gives only 0.85 kg instead of 1 kg

**Formula used:**

Profit% = (SP - CP) / CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let CP of 1.1 kg = ₹100

⇒ CP of 1 kg = 100 ÷ 1.1 = 90.91

He sells 0.85 kg for ₹100

⇒ SP of 1 kg = 100 ÷ 0.85 = 117.65

⇒ Profit = 117.65 - 90.91 = 26.74

⇒ Profit% = 26.74 ÷ 90.91 × 100 = 29.41%

**∴ The correct answer is 29.41%**

questions.question: The average runs made by a batsman in 10 innings of cricket was 43. How many runs does he have to make in the next inning so that the average of his runs increases by 3?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the average deviation method to find the required runs directly:

Runs required = Old average + (Total new innings × Increase in average)

Runs required = 43 + (11 × 3)

Runs required = 43 + 33 = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs in the first 10 innings = 43

Required increase in average = 3

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 

 Total 11 Innings → New Average: 46
 
 
 10 Innings (Avg = 43)
 
 
 11th = ?
 
 

 Deviation: 10 innings need +3 runs each
 11th Inning = 46 + (10 × 3) = 76

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs scored in 10 innings = 10 × 43 = 430 runs

⇒ Target new average for 11 innings = 43 + 3 = 46 runs

⇒ Total runs required in 11 innings = 11 × 46 = 506 runs

⇒ Runs required in the 11th inning = Total runs in 11 innings − Total runs in 10 innings

⇒ Runs required = 506 − 430 = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Concept

The average of any set of values is formulated as: Average = Sum of all values ÷ Total count of values.

Deviation Method for Included Items

When a new item is added to a group, its value can be quickly found without large calculations using: Value of added item = Old Average + (Total new items × Change in Average).

Combined Average

When two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ with averages A₁ and A₂ respectively are merged, the combined average is calculated as: (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: What is the area (in square units) of the triangle formed by the graphs of the equations: 2x - y + 8 = 0 and 8x + 3y - 24 = 0, and y = 0?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put y = 0 to find the base points on the X-axis: 2x + 8 = 0 ⇒ x = −4 and 8x − 24 = 0 ⇒ x = 3.

The length of the base = 3 − (−4) = 7 units.

To find the height, find the y-coordinate of the intersection of 2x − y + 8 = 0 and 8x + 3y − 24 = 0.

Multiply the first equation by 4 to get 8x − 4y + 32 = 0, and subtract it from the second: 7y − 56 = 0 ⇒ y = 8.

Area = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 7 × 8 = 28 sq units.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 sq units.**

questions.question: The point of intersection of the graphs of the equations 147x - 231y = 525 and 77x - 49y = 203, lies on the graph on the equation:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify both equations by dividing by their Highest Common Factor.

147x − 231y = 525 ⇒ Divide by 21 ⇒ 7x − 11y = 25

77x − 49y = 203 ⇒ Divide by 7 ⇒ 11x − 7y = 29

Add and subtract them to get simpler equations: 18x − 18y = 54 ⇒ x − y = 3 and 4x + 4y = 4 ⇒ x + y = 1.

Solving these mentally gives x = 2 and y = −1. Substituting (2, −1) into 9x − 5y yields 18 + 5 = 23, matching Option 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 9x − 5y = 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 147x − 231y = 525

Equation 2: 77x − 49y = 203

**Calculation:**

⇒ Divide Equation 1 by its HCF, 21:

⇒ 7x − 11y = 25 ... (i)

⇒ Divide Equation 2 by its HCF, 7:

⇒ 11x − 7y = 29 ... (ii)

⇒ Multiply (i) by 7 and (ii) by 11 to equalize coefficients of y:

⇒ 49x − 77y = 175

⇒ 121x − 77y = 319

⇒ Subtracting the first from the second gives: 72x = 144 ⇒ x = 2

⇒ Substitute x = 2 into (i):

⇒ 7(2) − 11y = 25

⇒ 14 − 11y = 25

⇒ −11y = 11 ⇒ y = −1

⇒ The point of intersection is (2, −1).

⇒ Check which given option satisfies x = 2 and y = −1:

⇒ Option 1: 9(2) − 5(−1) = 18 + 5 = 23 (Satisfies)

⇒ Option 2: 4(2) + 5(−1) = 8 − 5 = 3 ≠ 13

⇒ Option 3: 5(2) − 4(−1) = 10 + 4 = 14 ≠ 6

⇒ Option 4: 5(2) − 9(−1) = 10 + 9 = 19 ≠ 17

**∴ The correct answer is 9x − 5y = 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unique Solution

A system of linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ has a unique solution (intersecting lines) if a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂.

Infinite Solutions

A system has infinitely many solutions (coincident lines) if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂.

No Solution

A system has no solution (parallel lines) if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.

questions.question: What is the total surface area of a cone with diameter of 42 cm and height of 20 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter (d) = 42 cm

Height (h) = 20 cm

Radius (r) = d / 2 = 42 / 2 = 21 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of a cone = πr(r + l)

Where, l = slant height = √(r² + h²)

**Calculation:**

l = √(21² + 20²)

⇒ l = √(441 + 400)

⇒ l = √841

⇒ l = 29 cm

Total surface area = π × 21 × (21 + 29)

⇒ Total surface area = π × 21 × 50

⇒ Total surface area = 22/7 × 21 × 50

⇒ Total surface area = 3300 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
